adapters.rclpy.time.Time: Integer nanosecond arithmetic, comparison, seconds_nanoseconds and to_msg; not ROS clock domains.
adapters.rclpy.logging/node: Local logger and high-resolution perf_counter_ns clock; no DDS, ROS executor or services.
adapters.builtin_interfaces.msg.Time/mocha_core.m: Plain holders for Time, SMState and ClientStats telemetry; publish appends JSONL.
adapters.rclpy.serialization: Import-only placeholders; serialize_message and deserialize_message raise if called.
adapters.lz4.frame: Import-only placeholder; compress/decompress raise if called. Payloads are opaque supplied bytes.
adapters.InstrumentedChannel: Calls original callback_server/client unchanged; records requests, replies and arrival callbacks.
adapters.trigger: Explicit trigger_sync commands; RSSI discovery, translators and task topic consumers are outside this run.
